body: Two-level position tracking in emily-bot: (1) snapshot parser now extracts own entity from PacketSnapshot (id==myID) as server-authoritative anchor — resets dead-reckoning origin each tick; (2) dead-reckoning integration between snapshots: integrates prevFwd/prevStr × moveSpeed(8u/s) × dt(0.05s) in yaw-space on each think() tick. Also fixes bug: own entity was previously added to peers map, causing bot to sometimes aim at itself.
title: S38-02: emily-bot dead-reckoning + server-authoritative position
